high_level_description: stc brand style, a nurse in purple scrubs pushing an elderly woman in a black abaya and hijab in a wheelchair through a modern glass-walled hospital corridor.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A bright, modern hospital atrium with glass railings and marble flooring, lit with soft purple accent lighting.

elements.desc: A male nurse wearing purple medical scrubs, standing behind a wheelchair and smiling down at the patient.
An elderly woman wearing a black abaya and black hijab, seated in a wheelchair with her hands folded, looking up and smiling.
